title: sre-weekly-ops-sync-prep-2026-03-30
content: Meeting: SRE weekly ops sync + reliability review (prep notes)
Date/time: 2026-03-30 09:00-10:00 PT (prep for EMEA friendly hours) -- room: #sre-weekly, Zoom link in calendar
Attendees (prep): Samira (owner), Jordan (oncall lead), Ethan (serving-runtime), Alex M. (infra), Priya (observability) - ask for GCal RSVP confirm
Goal: quick SLO health check, triage paging trends, review top 3 incidents from last 2 weeks, agree on action items and rollouts that could affect reliability
Agenda (high level):
1) Quick rundowns (2m each): oncall highlights, major customer-facing alerts
2) SLO / error budget review (10m): monthly and 30d rolling, any burn > 30%?
3) Paging trends & root causes (10m): spike analysis, noise reduction opportunities
4) Incident deep dive (15m): INC-5432 (redis flapping), INC-5478 (model OCR regression), follow-ups
5) Upcoming changes (5m): infra deploys, capacity scaling, canary plans
6) Action items & owners (5m) + open questions
SLO snapshot (metrics pulled from dashboard 2026-03-29 20:00 PT):
- Hosted API (generation): availability 99.95% (monthly), 30d rolling: 99.92% -> 30d error budget burn ~38%
- Embeddings endpoint: availability 99.97% (monthly), 30d rolling: 99.98% -> burn low ~8%
- Dedicated inference pool SLO (p99 latency < 250ms): p99 last 7d = 290ms (regression), p95 stable
Notes on SLOs: p99 latency regression for dedicated pools correlates with autoscaler thrashing on nodes with mixed instance types (see infra/ASG change 2026-03-18). Need to decide rollback vs patch
Paging trends (last 14 days):
- Total pages to SRE rotation: 118 (avg/day 8.4) up from 6.0 last sprint (~40% increase)
- Top alert groups: API_5xx_rate (40% of pages), KV_CACHE_MISS_RATE (20%), infra node OOMs (15%)
- Noise source: low-severity alerts firing for transient GKE pod restarts after spot reclaim (tune threshold)
Root-cause hypotheses:
- API_5xx: downstream model timeouts when heavy batching + cold-starts from quantized model variants during bursts
- KV cache misses: cache eviction misconfig after recent mem tuning (PR #2147) - likely mis-sized LRU windows
- Node OOMs: misreported memory limits on a subset of Dedicated GPU instances after sidecar update (2026-03-22)
Top incidents to review:

INC-5432 (2026-03-20): Redis primary flapping -> cascade cache misses -> API 5xx spike (~35m). Postmortem draft: linked (JIRA). Follow-ups: add cross-replica failover test, increase replica-promote timeout from 10s -> 30s (Jordan), due 2026-04-06

INC-5478 (2026-03-24): Model OCR quality regression after quantize-runtime bump -> customer reports degraded accuracy for invoice parsing. Root cause: kernel selection fallback changed ordering. Action: revert runtime kernel ordering (Ethan), run model eval curve and smoke tests, estimate deploy 2026-03-31

INC-5501 (2026-03-28): Dedicated pool autoscaler oscillation causing p99 latency jumps for tenant X during job bursts. Mitigation: temp-silo tenant X to larger pool (Alex), medium-term: adjust scale-down cooldown and prefer larger instance types for that pool
Postmortem / follow-ups (open items):
- Jordan: add health-check escalation doc for Redis failover (draft done, need review). target: 2026-04-02
- Ethan: prepare kernel-order revert PR + canary plan, include perf benchmarks vs pre-change. target: 2026-03-31
- Alex: change autoscaler policy for dedicated pools (increase cooldown), run soak test against synthetic load. target: 2026-04-05
- Priya: add SLO-specific alerting noise filter (suppress brief flapping under 30s) and adjust runbooks. target: 2026-04-03
Open questions to raise in the meeting:
- Threshold for suppressing short-lived alerts: 30s vs 60s? trade-offs: hide real regressions vs reduce pager fatigue
- Do we prefer immediate rollback for kernel/runtime regressions or quick patch + canary? Need consensus (Ethan to propose runbook)
- Capacity: forecast for April (expected +25% traffic), do we pre-warm more Dedicated capacity or rely on autoscaling? finance implications
Quick wins / things to call out in sync:
- Reduce duplicate alerts: throttle API_5xx duplicate alerts (alert dedupe rule) (quick change, low risk)
- Add a small synthetic test hitting dedicated p99 path during the night to catch regressions earlier
Meeting prep TODOs (me):
- Pull final SLO dashboards (Priya) + one-pager summary (1 slide) - due 2026-03-29 (done)
- Ping Jordan/Ethan for incident owners to present short 3-slide summary each (today)
- Add links to PRs and postmortem drafts in meeting notes page (done)
- Bring up customer impact note for INC-5478 (we may need to reach CS) - Samira to sync with CS (Priya loop-in)
Scratchpad / things to remember during meeting:
- If p99 regression is infra-related (node types) ask Alex to show ASG change diff
- If revert is needed for runtime kernel order, confirm rollback window and staged canary targets (min 5% traffic then 25%)
- Ask oncall for brief timeline for last week: which alerts were noisy vs real
Notes-to-self (rough):
- Keep language customer-facing when discussing outage impact (avoid deep infra talk unless asked)
- Capture decision (rollback vs patch) in meeting notes and assign follow-up with due date
- After meeting: update runbook for redis failover and autoscaler policy doc (link in Confluence)
Possible linked work items / tickets to create:
- ENGOPS-1212: Autoscaler cooldown adjustment + soak test
- SRE-308: Redis failover cross-region test
- RUNTIME-89: revert kernel ordering + run perf/eval
Draft meeting close script (what I will say):

- Quick recap: we saw p99 regressions and a few customer-impacting incidents. We have owners and targets. Immediate short-term mitigations: throttle noisy alerts, temp-silo tenant X, kernel revert PR. Medium-term: autoscaler tuning and runbook improvements. We'll reconvene on action-item status next week.

- INC-5432 postmortem (draft): https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-5432

- Autoscaler config change: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/terraform/changes/ASG-2026-03-18
Final checklist before starting meeting:
- Confirm Jordan/Ethan attendance
- Make sure screen-share access for dashboards works
- Put meeting notes page in calendar invite (link: Confluence SRE weekly notes)
End of prep notes. Will update after sync with decisions + action items assigned (post-meeting summary).
